outputs.explanation: Panel A is a segmented 3D rendering (molecular/structural model) of the apical end showing actin nucleation at pre-conoidal rings; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B is a 3D segmentation/rendering of cytoplasmic actin bundles and pellicular actin, not a quantitative plot.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing filaments along the IMC surface, not a summary plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a schematic/structural rendering of a lateral section showing nuclear, cytosolic, and pellicular F-actin; it is not a data plot.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged subtomogram volume (an image), not a chart with averaged statistics requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a filament connected to a TPF by densities; it is not a plot of averaged values.
